messages.subject: Collaboration
messages.body_plain:
I am writing from behalf of our company BESeating. We are a restaurant furniture company that has more than 25 years of experience in supplying restaurant seating for indoor and outdoor use, which helped us gain confidence and keep quality consistency in everything we supply. We are based in NY, New York, USA.  Our wide range of products and huge stock availability helps us to keep our customers constantly satisfied. We have the shortest lead times for supplying commercial restaurant furniture and commercial hospitality furniture. We have over 40,000 products in stock. You can check out our extensive collection in our newly released amazing catalog -  https://online.flippingbook.com/view/498524/  . Your work is always informing and helpful, therefore we would like to ask if you would consider using our product photos for future blogs and articles and subsequentially refer our website. It would be very beneficial to work together.

Respectfully,

BESeating

George
/Marketing Manager/

BESeating
Office:
500 Broadway Ave.

Brooklyn, New York 11211

Tel.: 201-885-1222

in...@beseating.com
